# 梨花和服 (Rikawafuku)

> > Kimono and yukata rental service with locations across Kyoto (Kiyomizudera, Gion, Arashiyama), Tokyo (Asakusa), Kamakura, and Kawagoe, specializing in tourism experiences and school trip plans.

梨花和服 (Rikawafuku) operated by TripFarm株式会社 offers same-day kimono rentals with hairset included, featuring student discounts, couple plans, and LGBT-friendly services. The company provides coordination guidance, walking tips, and curated sightseeing routes near major temples and shrines.

## Key Topics

- 梨花和服 (Rikawafuku)
- 京都 (Kyoto) kimono rental
- 清水寺 (Kiyomizudera Temple)
- 祇園 (Gion) district
- 浅草 (Asakusa)
- 嵐山 (Arashiyama)
- 鎌倉 (Kamakura)
- 修学旅行 (school trip plans)
- 浴衣レンタル (yukata rental)
- カップルプラン (couple plans)
- 学割 (student discounts)
- ヘアセット込み (hairset included)
- 八坂庚申堂 photo spots
- 着物コーディネート (kimono coordination)
- LGBT-friendly services
